about_the_game:
An adventure triggered by headphones, from the extremely cold snowfields to the dark deep sea, you will experience the "art of death" composed of dense barrages.

With your heart beating faster and your fingertips sweating, you can dodge dense and deadly barrage attacks and experience the purest dodge operation.

Rely on calm judgment to complete seemingly impossible survival challenges!

Are you ready for the challenge?

Remember: in the barrage, calmness is survival, hesitation is destruction!

Add to your wish list and accept the barrage challenge immediately!

If you desire:

Experience the ultimate dopamine pleasure of traveling through the barrage

Enjoy dodging attacks and challenging the limits of your reflexes and concentration

Or just want to see this fantasy world of ice, snow and marine life in a dynamic musical atmosphere

So, give it a try!

Hi, I'm the developer of this bullet-hell dodging game. Just like you, I'm also a passionate gaming enthusiast.

I created this game in my spare time without a professional background or advanced technical skills. If you're interested in this bullet-hell dodging game and willing to spend a little time trying out the demo, it would mean a great deal to me.

How does it feel?

Is the gameplay smooth?

Is the bullet pattern challenging enough?

Does the BGM match well with the rhythm?

If you try the demo and enjoy it, please let me know! (Add to wishlist)

name: Give Me Back!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows® 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz 64 bits Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible graphics card with at least 512MB of video memory
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.5GHz 64 bits Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible graphics card with at least 1024MB of video memory
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: 《Give Me Back!》 is a barrage avoidance adventure game. It will take you into a fantasy world. During the adventure, you only need to avoid snowflakes, cross the waves, and overcome many difficulties to survive until the end. Here, reaction speed and calm judgment are the only rules of survival!
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
